Proposition
Source: topping:page-0048, topping:page-0049 1. ch3:2.10\group maximum-principle

Under Ricci flow, \[ rac{\partial }{\partial t}|\Rm |^2 \leq \Delta |\Rm |^2-2| abla \Rm |^2+C|\Rm |^3, \] where $C=C(n)$ and $\Delta $ is the Laplace--Beltrami operator.

Proof

\sketch Differentiating the metric contraction defining $|\Rm |^2$ and using the curvature evolution equation gives

\[ rac{\partial }{\partial t}|\Rm |^2 \leq 2\langle \Rm ,\Delta \Rm angle +C|\Rm |^3. \]

The identity

\[ \Delta |\Rm |^2=2| abla \Rm |^2+2\langle \Rm ,\Delta \Rm angle \]

then yields the displayed inequality after weakening the resulting estimate.

□
